run_optimal_transport_training: run the optimal transport training loop using Workspace.run with a Hydra config
create_workspace_instance: create a Workspace instance with a Hydra config to initialize the potential model and parameters
compute_dual_objective_loss: compute the dual objective loss for a batch using Workspace.dual_obj_loss with params
predict_transport_plan: predict the transport plan between distributions a and b using Workspace.pred_transport
compute_prediction_error: compute the marginal prediction error for a sample pair using Workspace.pred_error
